title: InvestmentDocument
description: An investment document the user imported (ADR-044), without its rows: Fintual's investment statement (holdings: the balance of every fund and series on one day) or its transactions certificate (movements: every contribution and withdrawal). Only a verified document is kept and used; issues say why one is not.

as_of.description: The statement's day, or the certificate's last movement; null when it could not be read.

imported_at.description: Null for a document that was not kept.

verified.description: It adds up; only a verified document is kept and used.
